name: Case Simulator RNG
creator: games by cool people
redeem: Launch Case Simulator RNG and finish the short tutorial if you are new.
Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen.
Scroll to the very bottom of the Shop to find the Redeem Codes section.
Type or paste the code into the Enter Code box and click Redeem.
notes:
Case Simulator RNG is a case-opening game inspired by CS2, made by the Roblox group games by cool people and released in late 2025. You open cases to unbox weapon and knife skins of varying rarity, sell or keep them to grow your inventory value, and use the money to open better cases. Auto-open and offline earnings keep progress going while you are away, rebirths add permanent boosts, and Case Battles let you open cases head to head against other players.

Codes usually give trait rerolls and short luck boosts, which raise your chances at rare drops. New codes tend to arrive at like milestones, with the next target posted in the game description, and alongside updates announced on Discord.

faq.q: Do you need anything before redeeming Case Simulator RNG codes?
faq.a: Your account has to reach Level 10 before the code box accepts anything, so open some cases first.

faq.q: When is the next Case Simulator RNG code coming?
faq.a: The game description says a new code will be released when the game reaches 140k likes. The current code, 120KLIKES, is named after the 120k likes milestone.

faq.q: What do Case Simulator RNG codes usually give?
faq.a: Mostly trait rerolls (usually 15 to 25) and timed luck boosts, such as +25% or 2x Luck for 20 minutes. The luck boosts raise your chances at rare skin drops. The current code, 120KLIKES, gives trait rolls.

faq.q: How do I get the Group Case in Case Simulator RNG?
faq.a: The game description says to like the game and join the Roblox group linked there to unlock the Group Case. It does not come from a code.

tips: Sell cheap skins you do not plan to keep and put the money into a better case. A growing inventory value is what moves you up the richest player leaderboard.
Turn on auto open when you will be idle for a while. The game also earns while you are offline, so coming back often to spend that money keeps you moving.
Rebirth once progress starts to slow down. The game says rebirths give boosts and power ups, so the reset pays you back after a short while.
Case Battles pit your openings against other players. Only join them with money you are happy to risk while you are still building up your inventory.
useRewards: 120KLIKES gives trait rolls, which let you reroll traits for a better result. Use them once you have a setup you plan to keep for a while, so a good roll is not wasted on something you will soon replace. Past codes have also given luck boosts that only last a short time, so activate those right before a long session of opening cases.
